title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E8 — Robert Klein, Lola Falana, Dean Martin
Flip visits Lola at the unemployment office; Klein does his classic Broadway audition routine and Dean Martin drops by.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E9 — Arte Johnson, Moms Mabley, Marcel Marceau
Arte’s a hopeless holdup man; Marcel does his classic Mask Maker pantomime and Moms gets a Geraldine makeover.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E11 — John Byner, Johnny Brown, Connie Stevens
Flip does mind-reading bit; Byner & Brown do competing impersonations and the entire cast does a Sherlock Holmes send-up.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E13 — Sid Caesar, Bobby Darin
Sid plays a hip musician, Jekyll & Hyde and a slot machine; Bobby & Flip offer a vaudeville routine and the cast does a silent movie.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E14 — ShaNaNa, Burl Ives, Slim Gaillard
Santa Claus (Ives) drops by the gas station; Gaillard & Ives do The Night Before Christmas and Rev. Leroy tells ShaNaNa about Scrooge.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E12 — Merry Clayton/Rev. Jesse Jackson
Merry Clayton, top back-up singer who emerged a star, sings "Grandma's Hands.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E13 — Chester Himes/The Dells
Author Chester Himes is welcomed back from self-exile in Europe on this show devoted primarily to his writings. Actor Al Freeman Jr., who reads from Himes' autobiography, and The Dells, who sing several of their hits, join the welcome.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E6 — The Triangle
Webster takes a picture and shows it to Katherine, who then starts to think that a neighbor is having an affair.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E7 — Parent Trap
As a lesson in teaching Webster responsibility, George and Katherine switch roles to where they are the kids and Webster is the parent.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E8 — Alien
Webster's friend Rob picks up a tabloid and asks Webster some questions from it. Webster gets the questions right and according to the tabloid, Webster is an alien from Jupiter and he starts to believe it.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E12 — Who's to Blame
Robbers break into the house while Webster is home alone and he has to know how to act.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E13 — Good Grief
Katherine is very upset when she finds out that her mother has passed away.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E13 — Little Man Date
Tia and her new beau Kyle decide to fix up Tamera with Kyle's little brother – who turns out to be a lot littler than anyone thought!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E14 — Ski Squad
A ski trip designed to give the twins some independence from their parents has them longing for the comforts of home after they're trapped in an avalanche.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E15 — Cafeteria Lady
Lisa gets a new job in the high school cafeteria, but her outrageous behavior proves to be a major embarrassment to Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E16 — Three the Heart Way
Dateless Tamera feels like a third wheel when Tia and Roger get matched up on Valentine's Day.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E17 — Model Tia
The family flashes back to the Disco Decade when Ray and Lisa attend a 1970s theme party, while Tamera falls prey to a man who promises to launch her modeling career.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E13 — Run, Mo, Run
An ex-con is after Moesha, and Dorian decides to search for his birth mother.
